svg.text: PR #8 · Sweep: explain the 'Actions may not create PRs' refusal and how to fix it
The first live sweep did everything right, then died on gh pr create with a bare GraphQL error;
now sweep_merged.py names the repository setting to flip, the alternatives, and that re-running is safe.

g.text: sweep.yml run 34192210361 · mode pr
4 permalinks verified · 4 descriptions confirmed · 4 files removed
branch visual-pr/sweep-2026-09-08 pushed
gh pr create --label no-visual
GraphQL: GitHub Actions is not permitted to create or approve pull requests
ERROR: could not open the sweep PR — exit 1, nothing else said

svg.text: a repository setting, off by default, hidden behind an API error
is the work lost? is it safe to run again? the log didn't say

g.text: A weekly job that fails on first contact with a fresh repo
and leaves the operator to reverse-engineer GitHub's permission model
sweep_merged.py · mode pr, same failure
ERROR line unchanged, then: match "not permitted to create or approve"
only that message triggers the hint; other failures stay terse
HINT: the repository forbids GitHub Actions from opening PRs
Settings → Actions → General → Workflow permissions → allow PRs
gh api -X PUT repos/O/R/actions/permissions/workflow … =true
or pass a PAT as token, or use mode: push
branch pushed; descriptions already updated; re-running is safe
Setting flipped here; re-run opened PR #7
0 descriptions updated, 4 files removed — idempotence held
First contact fails with instructions, not a mystery
README lists the setting beside the GITHUB_TOKEN caveat; test covers the hint

svg.text: The tool cannot flip the setting itself — GITHUB_TOKEN lacks administration scope — so this stays a one-time manual step per repository.
